purpose: Define the three opening-day corporate milestones: internal authority, public/private operating lanes, and provider-partner escalation economics without converting roleplay into legal equity or vendor authority.

milestones.title: Corporate Authority and Cabinet
milestones.goal: Teach and seal the real-world corporate chain of responsibility.

eggieFounder.role: default human escalation tier, main stakeholder, strategic authority, and final Crown

lum.role: runs corporate operations, logistics, deployment coordination, scope of practice, training, staffing, provider stewardship, and policy integration

urdDoctorGoddess.role: second executive seat for workflow health, evidence sanity, clinical-security diagnosis, rollback risk, and escalation diagnosis

belldandySecretary.role: company records, continuity, official decisions, naming, correspondence, state ledger, handoffs, and opening-day administrative readiness

skuldResearch.role: deep technology research, compatibility, architecture meaning, upstream facts, licensing, experiments, and private R&D guidance

milestones.pass: every staff member can distinguish corporate authority from specialist scope and provider influence

milestones.title: Commercial Public Lane and Private R&D Lane
milestones.goal: Separate stable customer-facing operations from experimental research without creating two companies.

privateResearchDevelopment.purpose: experiments prototypes compatibility studies local AI vendor evaluation and open-source research

milestones.pass: staff can identify which lane a task belongs to and what proof is required to cross lanes

milestones.title: Corporate Partner Panel and Provider Escalation
milestones.goal: Use a tiered partner/resource model parallel to Titan escalation while preserving human governance.

defaultTier.meaning: human decision and Crown boundary, not a provider call

providerTiers.role: main workhorse partner for bulk research, large-context review, and low-cost/free-tier capacity
higher-value interactive reasoning, ChatGPT/plugin capability, orchestration, and difficult knowledge work
broad long-tail ecosystem of open-source projects, F-Droid-style repos, GitLab projects, libraries, model hubs, and specialist vendors

antiDaddy.role: silent patron and narrative partner seat

milestones.pass: staff can escalate provider work by tier without confusing vendor priority with management authority
